public.flyway_schema_history.purpose: Technical Flyway installation history: ordered versions, scripts, checksums and execution outcomes; not a business aggregate.

public.hidra_alarm.purpose: Alarm-owned alarm state; standalone table name is an explicit prefix exception.

public.hidra_asset_maintainable_asset.purpose: Assets-owned maintainable-asset state; physical prefix is hidra_asset rather than hidra_assets.

public.hidra_custody_planning_product_po.purpose: Custody-owned product eligibility and approval-reference metadata consumed by Planning; actual approved values remain external and are not established by this dictionary.

public.hidra_hse_catalog_field_policy.purpose: HSE-owned field-role to approved catalog-family metadata, intentionally unseeded by its migration.

public.hidra_incident.purpose: Incident-owned incident state; standalone table name is an explicit prefix exception.

public.hidra_incident_closure_policy.purpose: Incident-owned classification/severity closure requirements and optional follow-up action types; actual approval and policy rows are not asserted.

public.hidra_incident_relationship_polic.purpose: Incident-owned explicitly approved direction and reciprocal relationship-type policy; not inferred from catalog codes.

public.hidra_integration_job_run_sequenc.purpose: Integration-owned per-job last run-number state with a job-definition foreign key; this is a table, not a PostgreSQL sequence.

public.hidra_integrity_catalog_field_pol.purpose: Integrity-owned field-role to approved catalog-family metadata, intentionally unseeded by its migration.

public.hidra_leak_detection_case.purpose: Leakdetection-owned case state; physical prefix is hidra_leak_detection.

public.hidra_org_operational_scope.purpose: Organization-owned operational-scope registry identity; referenced target state remains with its provider.

public.hidra_org_operational_scope_id_se.purpose: Identity sequence backing the Organization-owned operational-scope registry identifier; target business state remains owned by its referenced module.

public.hidra_org_reporting_line.purpose: Organization-owned reporting-line state; legacy reporting_line_type is retained as a trigger-synchronized compatibility projection, not the canonical classification.

public.hidra_planning_nomination_referen.purpose: Planning-owned per-nomination legacy-to-canonical owner reference mapping and approval provenance; business mappings remain subject to explicit owner approval.

public.hidra_planning_target_value_polic.purpose: Planning-owned target-type NUMERIC/TEXT representation eligibility; migration provides structure without approving or seeding business classifications.

public.hidra_residual_risk_assessment.purpose: Risk-owned residual-risk assessment; hidra_residual_risk prefix is an explicit exception.

public.hidra_telemetry_planning_unit_pai.purpose: Telemetry-owned approved quantity/rate unit compatibility metadata; dictionary ownership does not provision or approve unit pairs.

public.hidra_telemetry_planning_unit_rol.purpose: Telemetry-owned quantity/rate unit-role eligibility with approval provenance; no business role assignments are approved here.

public.hidra_topology_equipment.purpose: Topology-owned equipment state; legacy_equipment_kind is retained historical data and does not control the current catalog mapping.

public.hidra_topology_equipment_type.purpose: Topology-owned equipment-type state; legacy_equipment_kind is retained historical data and does not control the current catalog mapping.

public.hidra_topology_physical_network_r.purpose: Topology-owned append-only physical source revisions with canonical payload integrity; stored provenance and digest do not establish operational approval or live asset eligibility.
